hints: Compare either the measure of central tendency (medians) or the measure of spread (interquartile range or full range).
Mention specific values: median for A is 0.355 cm versus 0.352 cm for B, or IQR for A is 0.018 cm versus 0.024 cm for B.
State the comparison in the context of the diameters of the pipes produced by the two companies.
walkthrough:
Compare the medians of the two companies in context:
$$\text{Median of Company A} = 0.355\text{ cm} > 0.352\text{ cm} = \text{Median of Company B}$$

Alternatively, compare the spread (interquartile range):
$$\text{IQR of Company B} = 0.024\text{ cm} > 0.018\text{ cm} = \text{IQR of Company A}$$
State one conclusion: Company A produces pipes with a greater median diameter than Company B.
teacher_walkthrough:
Step 1: Choose a valid statistical measure to compare.
When comparing two distributions from box-and-whisker plots, a standard comparison can focus on either:
1. Location (Central tendency: comparing the medians).
2. Dispersion (Spread: comparing the interquartile ranges or ranges).

Step 2: Formulate the comparison.
- Option 1 (Median comparison):
  The median diameter of pipes from Company A ($0.355$ cm) is higher than that of Company B ($0.352$ cm).
- Option 2 (Spread comparison):
  The interquartile range of pipe diameters for Company B ($0.024$ cm) is greater than that of Company A ($0.018$ cm), indicating greater variability in Company B.
Either statement provides a valid comparison in context.

ai_rubric.Comparing Distributions: Compares median (A greater than B) or spread/IQR (B greater than A) in context. For this part: Make one comparison between the diameters of the pipes produced by companies A and B.
